title: The stool carried out
logline: Gully carrying a shop stool out onto the dock at dusk, from behind, and setting it beside the lawn chair. Nine months before the dock sequence needs it. The page doesn't know why he does it either.

panels.composition: A heavy gray man from behind carrying a shop stool out onto a dock at dusk toward an old lawn chair, the bay, string lights not yet up.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, a heavy gray-haired man seen from behind carrying a shop stool out onto a wooden dock at dusk toward an old lawn chair, a bay beyond, no words

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
art.palette: muted ochres, slate blues, misty sea-foam greens; luminous sunbreaks in the last spring
art.paper: Arches; bristol; the backs of motel registration cards
